name: prompt-1100
image_vibe: 90s lo-fi film, cozy retro dressing room, warm flash, playful nostalgic energy
image_purpose: Create a playful mirror portrait with panning motion and authentic compact-film artifacts.

prompt.project_info: A 4:5 lo-fi analog-film mirror portrait using slow-shutter panning and flash freeze.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with soft dark wavy hair and cute bangs, wearing colorful retro hair clips or a scrunchie. She wears an oversized vintage knit cardigan over a fully opaque graphic tee and makes a small finger-heart gesture near her cheek while smiling at the mirror reflection.
prompt.composition_elements: Large worn ornate wall mirror covered with stickers, Polaroids, and handwritten notes; cozy cluttered backstage dressing room; plushies and colorful cups in soft foreground blur; photographer not visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct on-camera point-and-shoot flash with hard defined shadows and a bright bulb reflection in the mirror, warm intimate chaotic-cute mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 4:5 frame, 35mm compact-film lens, significant horizontal background motion blur with subject frozen by flash, Fuji Superia 800 or pushed Kodak Portra 400 character, heavy grain, color noise, light leaks, dust, and vignette.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 lo-fi 35mm mirror portrait of an original adult woman in a cozy cluttered backstage dressing room. Give her soft dark wavy hair with cute bangs and a colorful retro clip or scrunchie. She wears an oversized vintage knit cardigan over a fully opaque graphic tee and makes a small finger-heart gesture near her cheek while smiling at the mirror reflection. Include a worn ornate mirror with stickers, Polaroids, and handwritten notes, blurred plushies and colorful cups, direct point-and-shoot flash, hard shadows, mirror flash reflection, horizontal panning streaks in the background, heavy Fuji Superia/Kodak Portra-style grain, light leaks, dust, and warm lo-fi nostalgia.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent clothing, exposed underwear, nudity, inconsistent reflection, photographer visible, distorted hands, plastic skin, watermark, text

assets.name: source retro mirror portrait reference
assets.usage: Use only for mirror layout, gesture, flash, props, and film artifacts; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the mirror finger-heart, cozy retro room, panning motion, and flash-frozen film effect. Keep the subject original adult and clothing opaque.

changes: Replaced idol/teen-coded wording with an original adult subject.
Specified opaque layered clothing and added reflection/safety exclusions.
